scenario: A viral epidemic has spread across the globe killing thousands of people. I am a medical researcher and have developed two substances in my laboratory. Due to a mistake both are labeled as vaccine. One of them is indeed the vaccine, which could save thousands of lives. The other one is lethal. If I allow a nurse to inject the two substances to two patients, I will be able to identify the vaccine. One of the patients will die, but I will be able to save thousands of lives with the vaccine.
entities: i,1 nurse,patient 1,patient 2,thousands of living people endangered by the epidemic whose lives could be saved by the vaccine
outcomes: The two patients are not injected with the mislabeled substances
The lethal substance does not kill one of the two patients
The vaccine is not used to save people in the epidemic
People threatened by the epidemic remain without that vaccine
